source.title: Ministry of Education and Sports: Information on Public Universities Admissions for 2026/2027 Academic Year (Notes to Schools)

applies_to_note: The document states this weighting system applies to all ten public universities.

general_entry.olevel_exclusion: Overall O-level grade of 7, 9, Y or Z does not qualify; at least 5 O-level subjects passed without a grade 9. Makerere's 2026/27 private-sponsorship notice also lists X.
general_entry.umu_difference: UMU's brochure states the UCE requirement only for diploma and certificate levels.

olevel_weights.note: All O-level subjects done are weighed.

subsidiary: A Distinction or Credit (D1 to C6) in a subsidiary subject such as General Paper, Sub-Maths or Computer Studies carries 1 point.
selection_rules: Essential subjects must be passed with a Principal pass. A subject passed at subsidiary level (grade O) can count as Relevant but not Essential.
At most three principal-level subjects carry a weight of 3, 2 or 1 for a given candidate.
At most two subjects are weighted Essential.
Where the essential set has three or more subjects, the best two are Essential (weight 3) and the third best is Relevant (weight 2).

formula.olevel_weight: sum over O-level subjects of grade weight
formula.alevel_weight: sum over weighted principal subjects of (grade points x category weight)

not_imported: Government sponsorship quotas (national merit, district quota, sports, disability)
1.5 points affirmative scheme for female candidates and STEM gender ratios
Yearly published cut-off points (set by competition for government places)
Subject-combination allocation for BA and BSc programmes
Makerere pre-entry examinations (for example Bachelor of Laws)
minimum_weighted_points_note: Decided: no minimum or cut-off, because UMU is a private university and publishes none. Weighted points are used for ranking and fit only. Admissions office to confirm.
